title: opcode
summary: Benilla's opcode.rs is the numeric opcode table for everything it sends and receives. The 2026-08-23 mechanical recount finds 424 current Benilla names, all 424 present in MSUI with zero numeric mismatches. MSUI additionally retains 62 implemented auction/ticket/login-feedback and SuperUI-specific constants not currently named by Benilla. CMSG_TOGGLE_HELM 0x02B9 and CMSG_TOGGLE_CLOAK 0x02BA now also have their exact empty-bodied WorldSession sends and guarded NetworkClient surface, with focused wire-shape checks.

openItems.text: Composite opcode-table inventory remains open and needs a fresh recount after this parity pass. Channel moderation, AUTOSTORE_BAG_ITEM and PET_SPELL_AUTOCAST are now present alongside the complete force-speed, base movement relay, observer MOVE_SET/SPLINE_SET speed, granted move-mode, server-scripted sound, weather, cooldown-extra, and implemented raid/group opcodes; several miscellaneous server-event families remain to inventory.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Fresh name/value recount against current benilla-protocol opcode.rs reports Benilla 424, MSUI shared 424, missing 0, numeric mismatches 0, and 62 intentional MSUI extras. Added the seven absent reference names (including the worldport MSG_/CMSG_ value alias) and a focused clinical fence.
